label: mainnet-atokens-two-hop
notes: Mainnet aEthUSDC -> aEthWBTC (Aave v3 aTokens): a long-tail pair with NO direct pool whose only routes are two-hop through dust v4 pools — the best is a chained v4>v4 route with a real intermediate amount. Pins two-hop enumeration, chained quoting, and multi-wave discovery on a golden where getQuote does NOT resolve in wave 0. (Originally tried as the no-route pair; the chain proved otherwise, which is why the no-route session uses non-transferable debt tokens instead.)
